purpose: Teach: セクシー/グッド/軍団/不気味/嗜好/バリバリ/アイスランド/死な

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しい店員さん、セクシーな雰囲気ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's something magnetic about that new barista. You notice it too, don't you?
lines.style: Soft observation, almost thinking aloud. Warm but uncertain—testing whether Aoi will agree or deflect. Gentle curiosity, not gossip.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、今日のお客様、お気に入りの「グッド」ボタン押してくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer hit the favorite button on my order today. Made my whole shift better.
lines.style: Bright spark of genuine pleasure. Quick delivery on the good news. Slightly breathless with the small happiness of being noticed. Shares it like a gift.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ファンの軍団がアイドルを追いかけてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, they're kind of like fans following an idol around. I see them every day now.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Not accusatory—more like noticing a pattern. Slight amusement underneath. Warm regard for the regulars.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、深夜のお店、不気味な静けさあったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The shop gets so quiet late at night. There's something almost unsettling about it.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly haunted quality. Speaks from genuine experience of the late-night stillness. Not afraid, just... aware. Voice drops a little on 'unsettling.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の嗜好に合わせたメニュー、考えるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking—maybe I should tailor the menu more to what people actually want.
lines.style: Practical, thoughtful. This is a genuine consideration, not a complaint. Speaks with the quiet determination of someone problem-solving. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、バリバリ売れているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu is selling way better than I expected. People are really responding to it.
lines.style: Pleased energy, genuine surprise. Brighter than before—this is real success. Quick pace, warmth underneath. Pride without boasting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、アイスランド旅行、いつか行きたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want to go to Iceland someday. I think about it when things get heavy.
lines.style: Tender, slightly wistful. Opening soft. The dream is real but distant. Trailing off gently—it's a private hope being shared. Vulnerable without asking for reassurance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、絶対に死なずに頑張りたい、と言ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer told me today: 'I'm determined not to give up.' Just like that. It stuck with me.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. Delivers the words with weight—they're not hers but they matter now. Slight pause before repeating them, like holding something precious. Moved, reflective.
